title: Character.AI Alternatives After the 2026 Chapter 11 Filing: A Dated Comparison
description:
A dated, sourced comparison of Character.AI and 11 other AI character chat and companion products after Character.AI's October 2026 Chapter 11 filing, covering memory mechanism, memory controls, free tier, paid price, age-check method, platform and app-store status, content policy and whether scenarios, story arcs and worlds can be composed with a character. Every row cites public URLs accessed on 2026-10-15; unknown values are marked 'not stated'. No ranking and no hands-on testing in v1.0.

Includes an events timeline (Character.AI Chapter 11 announcement, PolyBuzz iPhone app no longer on the App Store on 2026-10-15, Chai's July 2026 App Store absence, Kindroid free-tier change) and a FAQ, including 'Is it PolyBuzz or Pollybuzz?'.

Disclosure: the author is the founder of chatbrat.ai, which appears as one row described with the same rules as the others.
notes: Snapshot dated 2026-10-15. Prices are US listings and change frequently.
